title: Reduction to constructible prime torsion
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, let $C$ be a scheme proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] of dimension at most one, and let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf on $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], so that $(C,F)$ is a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting] with $C$ proper. Let $i:C_{\mathrm{red}}\to C$ be the reduction of $C$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction], and fix an algebraically closed extension $k'/k$. For a curve coefficient pair $(D,G)$ over $k$ write $\rho^q_{k'/k}(D,G):H^q(D_{\Et},G)\to H^q((D_{k'})_{\Et},G_{k'})$ for the pullback map [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback] along the projection $D_{k'}=D\times_kk'\to D$, i.e. the pullback map of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] for that morphism.

Assume: for every prime number $r$ and every constructible sheaf $G$ of $\mathbf F_r$-modules on $(C_{\mathrm{red}})_{\Et}$ (constructible in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] with $\Lambda=\mathbf F_r$; such a $G$ is killed by $r$, hence torsion, and $(C_{\mathrm{red}},G)$ is a curve coefficient pair with $C_{\mathrm{red}}$ reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] and proper), the map $\rho^q_{k'/k}(C_{\mathrm{red}},G)$ is bijective for every $q\ge0$.

Then $\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,F)$ is bijective for every $q\ge0$. In particular, if the hypothesis holds for every algebraically closed extension $k'/k$, then assertion $\mathcal C_7(C,F)$ [def-weil-pbc-C7] (the seventh of the eight curve assertions) holds.

The coefficient passage runs through filtered colimits of constructible sheaves, the primary decomposition of a constructible sheaf killed by an integer, and the exact sequences $0\to G[r]\to G\to G/G[r]\to0$.

proof.text: Let C0 be the nilradical subscheme of C, with inclusion i. The reduction lemma makes C0 reduced and i a surjective closed immersion, hence a universal homeomorphism. Its homeomorphism identifies topological dimensions, so i followed by f is a reduced proper curve. Pull i back along the given base-change projection to obtain P with projections a:P → C0 and j:P → Cprime. Paste the pullback squares to obtain the required field-extension square for C0. Properness gives qcqs source and target.

Let A be the underlying abelian sheaf of F and A0 = i^* A. The source stalk-torsion predicate agrees with local torsion; inverse image preserves local torsion, and the torsion characterizations identify this with IsTorsionAbelianSheaf A0. For every prime r, the hypothesis H applies to constructible ULift(ZMod r)-module sheaves on the reduced proper curve C0 and the pasted square. The new fixed-prime constructible approximation theorem therefore gives bijectivity for all abelian sheaves killed by r. Existing prime-torsion devissage gives bijectivity of cohomologyMap a A0 q for every q.

Topological invariance gives bijectivity for i and for its base change j. Functoriality identifies cohomologyMap a composed with cohomologyMap i with cohomologyMap(a followed by i), up to the cohomology bijection of upperStarComp. Thus the composite map is bijective. The pullback equation identifies a followed by i with j followed by the original base-change projection. Apply functoriality again and cancel the bijection for j and the composition isomorphism. The remaining map is exactly the original cohomologyMap in the required degree.

split_report.summary: Statement made precise against Stacks 03SC: a fixed algebraically closed k'/k, the pullback rho^q_{k'/k} of def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback / def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback, hypothesis on all constructible F_r-module sheaves on C_red for all primes r, conclusion rho^q(C,F) bijective for all q, hence C_7(C,F) [def-weil-pbc-C7] when it holds for all k'. stmt_deps: grab-bag def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves replaced by def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf (torsion) and def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf (constructible, Lambda = F_r); def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions replaced by its component def-weil-pbc-C7; added def-weil-pbc-curve-setting, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback and the new Mathlib leaf def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction (X.nilradical.subscheme). The imported one-paragraph proof is replaced by eight steps following the first two paragraphs of the proof of 03SC: (1)-(2) reduction to C_red via the new lem-weil-pbc-reduction-universal-homeomorphism (Stacks 054M) and prop-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-topos (03SI, same unit, Lean closed) instead of thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance (other unit), with the comparison square written out through the composition rule of lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial; (3) two-out-of-three for pullback isomorphisms through the new lem-weil-pbc-pullback-cohomology-long-exact-ladder (pullback maps commute with the connecting maps; no node existed) and lem-weil-pbc-five-lemma: this replaces lemma-weil-pbc-eight-curve-devissage, whose statement concerns the conjunction of all eight assertions and cannot be applied to C_7 alone; (4) filtered colimits through lemma-weil-pbc-curve-filtered-cohomology (used only for its first sentence; the compatibility with the ground-field extension is derived from naturality and lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-preserves-colimits); (5) F = colim F[n] and lem-kun-03sa (03SA(3), Lambda = Z/n) taken one after the other; (6) primary decomposition with thm-constructible-serre; (7) induction on the exponent with 0 -> G[l] -> G -> G/G[l] -> 0; (8) conclusion. The unreachable lemma-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-primary-reduction states the same reduction (for separated curves, extension invariance in general) with an uncited proof: it duplicates this node and is not cited; lemma-weil-pbc-curve-dense-open-reduction is the next reduction of 03SC (constructible F_l-sheaves to j_!G) and belongs to the parent's split, not to this statement.
